raw_html: [[Icy Burst#Icy Burst|Icy Burst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Icy Burst#Icy Burst|Icy Burst]]:''' This weapon is sheathed in icy cold, and deals 1 to 6 cold damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 cold damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
